Lead PM — Consumer Credit Card, London hybrid.

Quill Credit (London, 70 people) builds a credit card for near-prime UK consumers. We'll be upfront: we made a round of layoffs last quarter, our last funding round fell through and we are raising a bridge. We're hiring a Lead PM to own pricing experiments, underwriting flows and activation on the card, leading two PMs and reporting to the CEO. Hybrid, two days a week. Shipped consumer-credit product at growth stage is essential.

label_v2.edge_note: strong fit, red-flag company: low attractiveness drops it one tier
